title: Not surface-level. Not a script.
description: A real re-pattern — we move past insight into actual change using practical tools, real conversation, and zero pretending.

steps.title: Listen
steps.description: We start with where you actually are — not where you think you should be. No judgment, no script. Just an honest look at what's really going on.

steps.title: Uncover
steps.description: We map the patterns, beliefs, and quiet fears running the show. This is where everything starts to make sense and clarity finally arrives.

steps.title: Rebuild
steps.description: Together we install new ways of thinking, deciding, and showing up — and we practice them until they're genuinely yours to keep.
